name: local-preview
description: Preview your static site locally, right within VS Code. Run a static site generator like Docusaurus, Hugo, or Jekyll under the hood and see the generated page in a live split pane while you browse and edit the source.
author: Lars Wilhelmer

commands.title: Local Preview: Open in Split Pane

localPreview.mappings.description: Mappings of { pattern, url }. Pattern is a regex tested against the workspace-relative path, then the absolute path, first match wins. Url may use capture groups like $1.

localPreview.server.command.description: Command that starts your server (e.g. "yarn run start"). Runs in the background when a new preview opens and server.port is not in use. Stops when the split preview closes. Ignored in untrusted workspaces.

localPreview.server.port.description: Port the server listens on. If nothing listens there when a preview opens, server.command is run. 0 disables.

localPreview.followMode.description: When enabled, switching editor tabs opens the newly active file in the open split preview.

localPreview.followHeadings.description: When enabled, moving the cursor onto a Markdown heading scrolls the open split preview to that heading's anchor (file.html#my-heading).

localPreview.previewWidth.description: Width of the split preview in percent of the editor area when it opens. Applied only when two editor groups exist. 0 keeps VS Code's default split width.
